description: the words of the subsystem cam in an event row of a camera bucket (the open place of the Platform family events-unit — the root of the row, the fields beyond t, kind, id, of, class, occurred, v); the field type is set by the writing lesson — V/01.2 Н1.5; read by the console (/events, P/06.4 — as is) and the auto scenarios (V/07.2 Н1.3 — strictly)

port.description: the device input in the numbering of V/01.4 Н1.1, from 1

value.description: closed — the start of the alarm, open — the end: relative to norm of the input (V/01.4 Н1.4а)

dropped.description: frames dropped over the summary window

depth.description: the queue depth of the source

lines.description: rawData of the EventData row of the text source

group.description: the group number within the connection; outside a group there is no field

camera.description: the field camera of the eventsrc row (V/01.1 Н1.1г)

word.description: msg of the first matched element of words (V/01.2 Н1.5)

unit.description: the id of the row cam/device_units

event.description: the word of the unit template as is

phase.description: for a two-phase event: still — the phase is open, a repeat by the holder; an instant event has no field

det_kind.description: for a built-in detector: the kind by detector-kinds.tsv, outside the table other
